relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: The drug stabilizes the closed state of these NaV1.8 channels, which inhibits the generation of action potentials as pain signals that would otherwise propagate to the central nervous system

relationships.subject: CYP3A4
relationships.evidence_quote: The medication is metabolized hepatically by cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A), and the half-life is approximately 23.6 hours.

key_findings: Review: suzetrigine, a peripheral NaV1.8 blocker, showed noninferior analgesia to HB/APAP in phase 3 postoperative trials with fewer opioid-type side effects.
Suggests use in plastic surgery multimodal/ERAS regimens; cost and limited long-term safety data are barriers.
